summary: Verified the toolbar-cleanup bug fix in /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx on PHONE (390x844) and TABLET (1024x768) viewports. The 6 quick-color chips (quick-color-0..5) and the thickness chip (tool-thickness) have been fully removed from renderToolbar. Toolbar order on both viewports matches spec exactly: tool-undo, tool-redo, tool-pen-mode, family-pen, family-pencil, family-marker, family-tape, family-select, family-laser, family-eraser, tool-ruler — nothing below. Double-tapping Pen opens the tool popover with 'Pen settings' title, Fountain/Ballpoint variant chips, '3.0 pt' thickness readout + slider, 6 opt-quick-0..5 color chips, and 'More colors…' link — all visible and functional. All acceptance criteria in the review request are met.
critical_code_review_comments: Popover inline comment at line 1854 in /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx says 'the 4 quick colors' but the popover renders 6 chips (opt-quick-0..5). Minor cosmetic doc-comment mismatch — update to '6 quick colors' for accuracy.
seed_data_creation: None — 11 pre-existing handwritten note cards were already available in the DB and used for verification.
